column5: Cancer research resource is a link directory, not an enrolling roster. The specific clinical routes point to AVMA, NCI, known university rosters, BARC, ACI, Guardian, Hope, PetCure, SAGE and Santa Fe; official ACI roster shows its oral melanoma enrollment closed. Care and specialist pages excluded. Individual named provider protocols are reviewed under their sources.

Legacy list of external teaching-hospital and specialty-trials landing sites, not clinical protocols. Listed Auburn, CSU, Cornell, UC Davis, UF, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, NCSU, Penn, Purdue, Tufts and additional indices use older routes; clinical masters are reconciled independently rather than duplicate source records.

Listing says links verified Aug 20. It names AVMA, NCI, PetCure, ACI, OVC and university/clinic sites without presenting independent protocols. ACI is already in inventory and its only oncology listing explicitly says enrollment closed. Other linked primary masters are already in the queue.

Active dated phase I CTIS signal concerns humans. Canine hemangiosarcoma immunotherapy plus doxorubicin is a September 2025 results announcement, matching the existing research watch. Previously reported canine bladder study is a results signal; milestones and roadmap disclose no currently enrolling canine or feline study.

2023 official story reports use of gel after sarcoma resection in a Perth dog; separate UWA project reads Finished, and partner program and name/intervention searches revealed no successor intake. UWA retrieval recorded in supplemental web batch; no active public protocol added.

Official clinic post documents treatment at no cost for one patient in a UConn collaboration but names no drug, diagnosis, protocol ID, or general enrollment. Targeted partner, site and AVMA search did not establish the case identity or whether anyone can join; an unrelated NCI registry page is not evidence for it.

Official u10335 plans 40 dogs with spontaneous cutaneous neoplasia: bleomycin electrochemotherapy vs calcium electroporation. Oct 2025–Feb 2027 is project timing, not a published intake window; PI profile/related pages and Portuguese searches do not establish patient referral or funding. Separate u7937 eyelid excision/cryosurgery is a comparison of procedures, with neither current intake nor a confirmed malignant-only cohort.

October 2025 recruitment notice identifies vaccine targets CTLA-4 and PD-L1, oral melanoma stage II–III, age one year or older, two arms, and exact eight participating centers. The sponsor's current news pages still link the unchanged original invitation; November 2026 posts are unrelated. Current site-by-site capacity, cutoff and sponsor funding are not published; separate Evergreen IL-15 identity excluded from this comparison.

2016 owner PDF describes laparotomy-based tissue diagnosis and treatment tailored to histologic subtype, with standard chemotherapy described rather than experimentally allocated anticancer intervention. 2020 account is retrospective context; no new dated owner recruitment protocol surfaced.

Nebumet program, capital raise and Spain OMICA diagnostic monitoring collaboration refer to one inhaled therapy registration program tracked in four country rows. Partner work and capital raise do not identify site-level current recruitment or new protocol; no expansion in confirmed roster.

Investigator confirms current DOG-FIGhT using ferumoxytol as radiosensitizer; his chlorambucil and M032 projects are explicitly prior and different. University and named-clinic searches located no direct current intake, date, complete locations or funding; maintain exact trial as already tracked without changing access or publishing clinical verification date.

Mapped laboratory URL now redirects to the Warsaw SGGW veterinary faculty portal/Polish graduate admission. Archive and Polish searches for dog tumor research and nanoparticle recruitment did not show an open owner-facing protocol. University research links alone cannot establish an enrolling trial.

Label Abiertos conflicts with historical identity: feline macroscopic mammary Palladia exact study appears in ESVONC 2014 results, AB07008 masitinib in sponsor 2015 update. Palladia plus NSAID inflammatory mammary has only a title; phase II trocoxil has detailed but undated clinic terms and no independent contemporary intake. Bone analgesia is supportive rather than tumor-targeting. No current new trial published.

Current sponsor lists one Kv9 protocol, referring veterinarians can request screening, funding separates screening from treatment, and sponsor FAQ states no set enrollment end. This establishes the named program roster only. Individual location capacity and any newly announced individual treatment site were not inferred from an old wider-area press report.

The current university trial roster has two oncology-linked dog studies. Probiotic versus placebo measures intestinal effects while separately elected CHOP is background care; pain/activity monitoring in irradiated dogs tracks symptoms with no assigned anticancer treatment. Zero eligible treatment trials on this official source.

Official Portuguese COE page explicitly offers screening by consultation for unspecified sponsored Phase I–III clinical studies, but names no treatment, tumor, current study code or patient-facing eligibility/funding for an exact protocol. Targeted site/Portuguese searches yielded the same program page, no current protocol. Do not add as service or trial.

Oncology roster: colorectal stool/biopsy is diagnostic; CarboPop measures pharmacokinetics on prescribed carboplatin and shows June 2022 end. Canine TG6002 CANC_2019_1 has no end on the old Alfort listing; researchers published a 13-dog TG6002-plus-oral-5FC cohort and a 2026 review found one completed reported efficacy cohort, but the publication's detailed protocol ID was not independently read due to CAPTCHA on PMC and an empty PubMed renderer. No contemporary invitation found.

Current master names feline mammary surgical GCN2-IN-6 with free study drug and one named hospital. Older owner and vet referral pages describe distinct anti-EGFR nanobody-guided resection, tied by intervention and investigators to completed partner VUB project ANI305 (2025-11-30); documentary follow-up found no successor recruitment. The separate fluorescence-lifetime ICG project is already tracked under be-ghent-fluorescence-lifetime-cancer-surgery, nonmatchable; no implication from the older nanobody invitation.

Six qualifying procedures reconciled, with plexus ZH026/2023 and general soft tissue sarcoma separate cohorts. Cardiac and endocrine cohorts only observe sequelae of radiation, PET-CT is diagnostic, vinorelbine is dose-finding, ADAM-12 feline safety protocol remains nonmatchable. Lattice detailed inclusion is dogs despite generic dog/cat header; two specific financial brochures remain exact-held, so no funding re-verification or extension to cats.

Current trials programme and FAQ describe study participation but do not list individual veterinary oncology treatment protocols; the long list is historical outcome/news or research, not recruitment. Oral melanoma tigilanol question checked separately and no current protocol intake appeared; do not infer it is closed merely from absence.

Lab lists paid-via-veterinarian production of autologous CANCV for individualized care and describes prior animal experiences; a 2024 education paper also refers to formulation and prior use. No currently identifiable trial admission or cutoff; keep separate from experimental registry.

Four public examples align with Cornell oral trametinib, Georgia exact IVP (only indexed official body on an exact-held direct URL, not a new clinical review), Ohio State anti-MIC/NK and UC Davis liver TAE or TACE. Direct Ohio page says $700 while official flyer says $800; source discrepancy logged separately. Public testing-center pages are index counts/descriptions only. Full service behind paid/personal application was not attempted.

The oncology item titled Palladia thyroid-function actually repeats verbatim the distinct osteosarcoma nerve-block protocol. The active leaf in both routes evaluates relief of pain when radiation/resection/amputation are unavailable and assigns no cancer-targeted treatment. No eligible anticancer treatment recruitment published on this roster.

DVG is a linked directory. Legacy Zurich route unavailable, current university source resolves the individual identities. DVG's separately published May 2026 Zurich-authored flyer confirms feline FLASH contribution and revised follow-up. Sarcoma and plexus surgery link to distinct known records; ADAM12 phase 0 and lymphography, PET or right-atrial screening are not new public treatment trials.

Resource links institutional sources and individual dogs-with-OSA alternatives. Cornell SINE is now confirmed completed, CSU dual energy CT and OVC blood test diagnostic, Kansas State pain monitoring is supportive, Penn cell therapy remains exact tracked separately, Virginia Tech histotripsy was archival, UF RNA plus anti-PD1 is known. No second instance of these records.

UKRI first-party grant project is antibody design, expression and pre-clinical validation, with Queen's Belfast and funder partners. Native landing lacked abstract; permissible public Web returned named project text. No canine participant protocol, site or recruitment date established.

SLU project catalogue confirms September 2026 to August 2030 for home-based Silver Bullet 2.0, distinct from the earlier two-disease safety pilot. Brazilian grant to underpin execution does not establish Brazilian intake. Swedish site searches identify no owner enrollment announcement for either. Project date is not recruitment cutoff when recruitment itself is unconfirmed.

UQ school/UQ VETS currently names bone-cancer vaccine, two formulations within one identity. Enzistat is a different formal study with palliative and preoperative downsizing arms in February institutional release. Current school index, exact intervention and sponsor searches give no contemporary confirmation of still-open Enzistat slots or cost; leave candidate pending, not a duplicate.

Centre's named project links: PET-CT and prior auranofin reported completed; tigilanol in six dogs reported completed; lymphoma irradiation and prostate pages describe service or prior results and contain no current protocol criteria; SCC skin bacteria project is research without assigned anticancer treatment. No active owner-facing qualifying protocol.

JASMINE names Azabu and Nihon for prospective-phrased canine nasal adenocarcinoma radiation. Azabu found cohort treated 2008–22, which is retrospective; Nihon's current index shows different four oncology protocols. JVCOG direct master explicitly closes DNA vaccine intake for canine B-cell lymphoma; the older flyer is not an open alternative. No direct prospective timing, exact intervention details or site enrollment for the named nasal trial.

BARC direct lengthy master confirms photothermal gold nanoparticles and intratumoral carboplatin for superficial SCC, plus local Yale/TheraJan EGFR. Paclitaxel and B-cell development enrollment closed, TLR and FMT explicitly coming soon despite old forecast. Gilvetmab plus carboplatin/EGFR comparison is mentioned, but separate current qualifying sites, cohort, protocol identifier and funding not published; do not publish a second arm as a new trial.

iCAT research newsroom describes feline PD-1 and separate canine anti-CD20, whereas CAR-T development is preparation, not recruitment. Sample and student invitations excluded. Detailed hospital page exact-held; protocol-level care review assigned under JSAMC rather than treated as an independent iCAT enrollment roster.

Current secondary API pages 1–3 yielded 293 distinct records, with 106 oncology-keyword candidates. Per-row identity and action are in vettrials-crosswalk-manual.tsv and raw compact candidates; do not accept secondary statuses. Instances of clearly historical Google-indexed listings, held exact URLs, supportive/diagnostic studies and unexplained current recruitment remain labeled individually.

Native capture has placeholder empty filtered list and outbound AVMA, aging TRIAD and member VIN links. Permitted Web renders separate content including undated Murdoch solid-tumor checkpoint combination marked Coming soon, no protocol or enrollment on official Murdoch routes. Other visible studies unrelated; open site does not establish Australian oncology trial.

R&D shows 30-dog phase II randomized mammary carcinoma after surgery, and feline SCC supplement alongside electrochemotherapy. Primary home classifies studies as previously conducted; product flyer describes nutritional supportive supplement. No current clinic intake, date or qualifying therapeutic cohort is published. Exact sponsor R&D and new product pages cross-checked.

Direct master only named applicable veterinary oncology trial is the Cornell SINE/verdinexor-carboplatin cohort. Current and historical sponsor marketing recruiting text is overridden by exact AVMA VCT24005828 Completed per owner policy. Other master listings are Valley Fever and respiratory studies, and no distinct candidate was found.
